name: Trazodone
summary: Trazodone is an antidepressant with serotonergic activity. This profile remains research-only while major-depression efficacy, off-label sleep evidence, cardiac/QT, serotonin-syndrome, orthostatic, priapism, interaction, and regulatory evidence is assembled and reviewed.
description: Canonical trazodone entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until indication-specific scientific evidence, off-label sleep-use boundaries, interaction and cardiac safety, and regulatory provenance has passed the site’s review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: serotonergic signaling; serotonin reuptake inhibition and receptor antagonism
safety_notes: U.S. prescribing information carries a boxed warning about suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients and includes serious warnings for serotonin syndrome, QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, orthostatic hypotension and syncope, bleeding risk, priapism, and activation of mania or hypomania. Trazodone is not FDA-approved for insomnia. This summary is not exhaustive; consult current product-specific prescribing information.
